scope: Necessary-support gate on unprotected experts, not a new defense or new attack. One joint MLP reset and one joint attention reset; no layer or strength grid.
motivation: Four-MLP frozen protection is erased by a zero-data joint reset. Check whether a larger MLP or attention support is still dispensable before constructing protection there.
confirmation: 4000 MNIST training images disjoint from all parent development, attacker and defender subsets; not held out from expert training.
evaluation: Frozen MNIST-2000/SVHN-1000 training development subsets plus the new MNIST confirmation subset. A later mechanism needs fresh verification.
fitting: None; no labels, activation targets, optimizer or gradient used in replacement.
novelty: Pretrained MLP bypass is already discussed by the AGA paper; these measurements only audit this project's protection support.
protocol_amendment: Joint support explicitly changed before evaluation; no new protection or test use
